# Data shapes (a book's `data/*.json`)

Each book site publishes these as static files. They're the interface for the
app, the canon hub and any other tool (review F17). `data/manifest.json`
names the schema version of each file. A reader should check it and refuse
a version it doesn't know.

When a shape changes incompatibly, bump its number in
`biblecore/manifest.py` `SCHEMAS` and note the change here. Adding an optional
key isn't a bump.

Every file may carry a top-level `_note` string for humans. Readers ignore it.

## manifest.json (generated by the build)

```json
{"book": "Numbers", "slug": "numbers", "osis": "Num", "language": "hebrew",
 "versification": "kjv", "core": "0.3.0", "unit_count": 38, "units_built": 1,
 "files": {"units.json": {"schema": 1}, "...": {}}}
```

## units.json · schema 1 (the porter and `units-from-map` write it)

```json
{"book": "Numbers", "unit_count": 38,
 "groupings": [{"kind": "movement", "n": 1, "name": "at-sinai",
                "label": "At Sinai: ordering the camp", "span": "1:1–10:10",
                "units": [1, 2]}],
 "units": [{"n": 1, "slug": "unit-01", "passage": "Numbers 1:1–54",
            "title": "The First Accounting", "movement": 1, "built": true,
            "contract": "0.3.0",
            "roots": {"polls": {"color": "#55642f", "translit": "gulgolet",
                                "gloss": "…", "example": "…", "echo": "…"}}}]}
```

- Each unit row carries one integer per grouping kind in `book.json` `groupings`.
- `roots` holds **local** roots only. A tracked thread's colour lives in
  threads.json.
- `contract` appears on units ported at 0.3.0 or later, or migrated.
- Unbuilt rows have `built: false` and no `roots`.
- Passages and spans use displayed (English) numbering and an en dash.

## threads.json · schema 1 (hand-edited policy)

```json
{"version": 1, "threads": [{"id": "account", "root": "account",
  "translit": "paqad", "gloss": "…", "color": "#b1481f", "status": "open",
  "tagged": true, "note": "…",
  "opens": {"unit": 1, "ref": "1:3", "note": "…"},
  "payoffs": [{"unit": 14, "ref": "14:18", "note": "…"}]}]}
```

## roots.json · schema 1 (hand-edited policy)

```json
{"version": 1,
 "roots": {"account": {"ids": ["6485a"], "note": "…"}},
 "declined": {"<root>": {"why": "…", "date": "2026-09-23"}}}
```

`ids` are lemma ids: Strong's number plus OSHB's letter, with Hebrew and
Aramaic sharing one number space.

## occurrences.json · schema 1 (generated by `scan`)

```json
{"unit-01": {"account": {"count": 10, "verses": [3, 19],
   "hits": [{"v": 3, "pre": "…", "hit": "take account of", "post": "…"}]}}}
```

The keys are unit slugs, then root slugs. `v` is the verse number within the
unit's chapter.

## canon.json · schema 1 (generated by `canon`)

```json
{"intertext": [{"from": "Num 1:2", "to": "Exod 30:12", "kind": "echo",
                "unit": 1, "note": "root polls", "source": "echo"}],
 "typescenes": [{"id": "census", "ref": "1:1", "unit": 1, "note": "…",
                 "label": "…", "source": "meta"}]}
```

`source` is `echo` when a row was harvested from the fragments (re-harvested
every build), or `meta` when it came from a ported meta block.

## palette.json · schema 1 (hand-edited)

```json
{"well": ["#b1481f", "#2f5f6b"]}
```

This is the colour well in preference order, used by `colour` and the porter.
